rules.title: FEHA Source of Income Protection for Rental Housing
rules.requirement: California landlords cannot refuse to rent to, or treat differently, an applicant or tenant because of how they pay rent, including use of a Section 8 housing choice voucher, rental assistance, SSI/SSDI disability benefits, or wages.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to most housing providers and housing-related services statewide; exceptions exist for an owner occupying the home and renting to one additional person.
rules.exemptions: When an owner is occupying a home and is renting to one additional person, the owner may exclude applicants based on protected characteristics (though discriminatory advertising is still prohibited).
rules.quoted_span: California law protects tenants from discrimination based on how a tenant will be paying rent (“source of income”). This includes the State of California’s COVID-19 Rent Relief Program, Housing Choice (Section 8) vouchers, (SSI) social security disability benefits, or wages earned from a job.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: Whether the owner occupies the home and is renting to only one additional person (owner-occupant exemption)
